name: pcb_fixture_cube001
status: Unity-derived fixture reference; verify against the manufactured fixture before robot execution

coordinate_frame.name: board_center
coordinate_frame.origin: geometric center of the PCB top surface
coordinate_frame.y: board depth direction; Unity +Z; fixture handle points toward +Y
coordinate_frame.z: upward from the PCB top surface; Unity +Y

board.fixture_seating: fixture broad upper support surface is aligned with the PCB underside
board.board_pose_rule: the four inner PCB mounting holes are concentric with the four fixture pins

pin_pattern.purpose: registration pins into the inner four PCB mounting holes

alignment_from_unity.rotation_rule: rotate the FBX so its thin axis is Unity +Y, then orient the handle toward board +Y
alignment_from_unity.support_surface_note: computed from fixture mesh in Unity; measure the printed fixture before descent

robot_use.transform_rule: detect the physical board pose, then apply board-relative part coordinates; do not use fixture coordinates as robot-base coordinates
robot_use.collision_rule: keep the gripper and part above the board target until board pose and fixture seating are validated

verification_checklist: Confirm the handle is on the board +Y/north side.
Confirm all four pins enter the inner four PCB holes without force.
Measure the actual pin spacing and board seating height.
Capture the board pose after the PCB is seated in the fixture.
Validate each placement slot with a TCP hover before lowering.
